markdown_content: # CLO 2025.2 New Features Overview (廣東話 Cantonese) This document details the new features and updates introduced in CLO 2025.2, including the Neat Swatch Editor, Pattern Drafter enhancements, GPU-accelerated soft body simulation, UI improvements, MetaHuman avatar support, shortcut key search, 2D and 3D tool updates, animation keyframe expansion, UV Editor enhancements, rendering improvements, and workflow lead time and cost-saving analytics. --- ## Neat Swatch Editor: Advanced Yarn Structure Design and Real-time Editing This section explains the Neat Swatch Editor, a new tool in CLO 2025.2 that allows users to design yarn structures directly within the 3D file, simulate shrinkage effects more accurately, and edit yarn samples in real time. ### Key Features and Operation - **Accessing the Editor:** - Select a material in the Material window. - Change material type to *Neatware*. - Click the ball-shaped *Neat Swatch Editor* icon next to Neatware or access it from the 2D Window Toolbar. - **Navigation Controls:** - Middle mouse button: flat movement. - Mouse wheel: zoom in/out. - Right mouse button + drag: free rotation. - Shortcut keys (2,4,6,8) switch preview views similar to the 3D window. - **Sand Line Display Modes:** - **Thick Yarn:** Displays roughness and purity. - **Thin Yarn:** Shows stamp structure and visibility. - **Random Color Yarn:** Uses actual roughness to color rows randomly for structure inspection. - **Core Settings:** - Input *Wealth Amount* (vertical line circles) and *Cross Amount* (horizontal line circles) to design stamp size. - Click *Rebuild Reset Swatch* for immediate updates. - Adjust roughness and *Gauge* (yarn thickness) with options accessible via a triangle dropdown. - Link icon toggles automatic measurement values or manual input for parameters like rows per inch. - **Tips:** - Changes in yarn thickness or amount update samples automatically without needing to press Reset again. - Hovering over settings shows tooltips explaining their function. - **Needle Types Supported:** - Front Knit (Q) - Back Knit (W) - Front Miss (E) - Missed Loop in Front & Floating Back and Back Miss (R) - **Editing and Simulation:** - Drag and drop to edit samples instantly. - Press *Simulation* or spacebar to preview corrections. - Simulation can be toggled on/off while continuing edits. - Apply changes to 3D clothing via *Apply* or *Apply and Close* buttons. - When the editor is active, certain gauge options are locked to ensure changes are managed through the editor. - **Additional Editing:** - Customize color direction, thread color, and seam generation on Neat Samples. The Neat Swatch Editor enables creation of more precise and complex knit samples, improving design accuracy and realism. --- ## Pattern Drafter Enhancements: Neat Swatch Integration and AI Skirt Import This section covers updates to the Pattern Drafter that introduce Neat Swatch types and AI-assisted pattern creation, allowing more precise pattern development and data-driven adjustments. ### Neat Swatch Pattern Creation - New options for *Neat Swatch* and *Neat Swatch with Darts* are added to the Pattern Drafter menu. - Measurement modes: - **General Mode:** Allows precise adjustment of multiple parameters. - **Simple Mode:** Basic adjustments focusing on key measurements. - Darts management: - Automatically calculates dart number based on waist measurements and waist difference. - Iron chain icon indicates automatic calculation of length and positions; can be toggled to manual input. - Example settings: - Total length set to 750. - Hip width set to 1,000. - Cross Drop Length set to 270. - Leg Opening length set to 500 (auto-adjusts thigh width). - Users can adjust dart positions, lengths, and width of thigh areas interactively. - Data can be saved as CSV files for reuse and imported later to avoid manual re-entry. ### AI Pattern Drafter: Half-Body Skirt Import - Allows importing skirt designs using AI prompts or reference images. - Workflow: 1. Open Pattern Drafter and click AI icon. 2. Import prompts or upload images. 3. Select skirt type and enter descriptive keywords or use suggested prompts. 4. Generate skirt pattern and preview in 2D window. 5. Make minor adjustments and finalize by clicking *Create*. - The skirt is automatically arranged on the avatar with seam lines added. - Simulation can be used immediately to check fit and make further changes. --- ## GPU-Accelerated Soft Body Simulation This update adds support for GPU acceleration in soft body simulations, improving simulation speed and realism. - Supported only on Windows systems with NVIDIA GPUs. - Enable by selecting the avatar and activating *Soft Body* in the Property Editor. - Soft Body icon appears in the 3D window. - Change the simulation mode to *GPU* and run the simulation for accelerated results. --- ## User Interface (UI) Improvements Key UI enhancements for improved workflow flexibility: ### Library Window Flexibility - Library window can be docked on the left or right side of the toolbar. - Toggle the library window visibility by clicking the blue bar on either side. - Can return to the original round window layout by clicking the soft body icon. ### Shortcut Key Search - Added search function for shortcut keys in *User Settings* under the main menu. - Allows users to quickly find and customize shortcut keys by entering names or key combinations. --- ## MetaHuman Avatar Support CLO 2025.2 supports importing MetaHuman avatars from Unreal Engine: - Access via main menu > Import > MetaHuman. - Select DNA file and configure options such as unit scale and proportion. - Option to automatically add arrangement points and fitting suits. - Imported MetaHuman avatars are added directly to the working area for use. --- ## 2D Window Enhancements ### Graphic Placement Accuracy - Transform Graphic Tools now include preset moving modes. - Users can precisely move graphics by entering numeric values. - Options include centering and outlining movements relative to paper edges. ### Grading Improvements - All grading cutouts, including sewing lines, are visible and synchronized with notches in the 2D window. - Notch positions can be locked or manually edited for precise grading control. - Sewing lines remain perfectly aligned with notches across different grading sizes. - Reverse direction options available for square grading marks. --- ## 3D Window Tool Updates ### Pins Tool: Sketch-Based Deletion - New function enables deleting pins based on a user-drawn sketch instead of deleting entire pin groups. - Select sketch area, right-click, and choose *Delete Pins On Selected Patterns* for precise pin removal. ### Tag Tool Activation Toggle - Tags installed on garments can now be temporarily deactivated in simulations without removing them. - Activation toggle available in Property Editor. - Tags remain visible in files but do not affect simulation when deactivated. --- ## Avatar and Accessory Management ### Hat Accessory Registration - Users can register hats as avatar products. - After registration, hat papers become hidden (white) to simplify the workspace. - Unregistered hats disappear when the avatar is hidden. - Hat accessories can be deleted or hidden via the *Delete Accessory* option. ### Pull Chain Synchronization - Pull chains can be symmetrically copied to matching paper icons. - Selecting *Copy to Symmetric Patterns* duplicates pull chains with original materials intact. --- ## Animation Editor Keyframe Expansion Significant enhancements to keyframe functionality and usability: - Keyframes can now be applied to additional attributes: pressure, false band, shrinkage, solidify, trims. - Animation editor auto-opens when setting keyframes (previously manual). - Supports adding keyframes across multiple layers and objects simultaneously. - New toolbar options to add keyframes to selected layers or all object layers (costumes, avatars, pins, wind controller). - Example workflow: - Select paper image. - Click keyframe icon next to attribute (e.g., pressure). - **Accessing the Editor:** - Select a material in the Material window. - Change material type to *Neatware*. - Click the ball-shaped *Neat Swatch Editor* icon next to Neatware or access it from the 2D Window Toolbar. - **Navigation Controls:** - Middle mouse button: flat movement. - Mouse wheel: zoom in/out. - Right mouse button + drag: free rotation. - Shortcut keys (2,4,6,8) switch preview views similar to the 3D window. - **Sand Line Display Modes:** - **Thick Yarn:** Displays roughness and purity. - **Thin Yarn:** Shows stamp structure and visibility. - **Random Color Yarn:** Uses actual roughness to color rows randomly for structure inspection. - **Core Settings:** - Input *Wealth Amount* (vertical line circles) and *Cross Amount* (horizontal line circles) to design stamp size. - Click *Rebuild Reset Swatch* for immediate updates. - Adjust roughness and *Gauge* (yarn thickness) with options accessible via a triangle dropdown. - Link icon toggles automatic measurement values or manual input for parameters like rows per inch. - **Tips:** - Changes in yarn thickness or amount update samples automatically without needing to press Reset again. - Hovering over settings shows tooltips explaining their function. - **Needle Types Supported:** - Front Knit (Q) - Back Knit (W) - Front Miss (E) - Missed Loop in Front & Floating Back and Back Miss (R) - **Editing and Simulation:** - Drag and drop to edit samples instantly. - Press *Simulation* or spacebar to preview corrections. - Simulation can be toggled on/off while continuing edits. - Apply changes to 3D clothing via *Apply* or *Apply and Close* buttons. - When the editor is active, certain gauge options are locked to ensure changes are managed through the editor. - **Additional Editing:** - Customize color direction, thread color, and seam generation on Neat Samples. The Neat Swatch Editor enables creation of more precise and complex knit samples, improving design accuracy and realism. --- ## Pattern Drafter Enhancements: Neat Swatch Integration and AI Skirt Import This section covers updates to the Pattern Drafter that introduce Neat Swatch types and AI-assisted pattern creation, allowing more precise pattern development and data-driven adjustments. ### Neat Swatch Pattern Creation - New options for *Neat Swatch* and *Neat Swatch with Darts* are added to the Pattern Drafter menu. - Measurement modes: - **General Mode:** Allows precise adjustment of multiple parameters.
